summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the rulings add up to, which reviews' evidence fell short, and any coverage gap.

items.description: One item per distinct claim, duplicates merged, sorted by severity, highest first.

severity.description: The highest supported severity among the sources: a source's severity its evidence does not support counts at the highest severity it does.

ruling.description: fix, waive: the evidence holds and its scope is change or goal: the change introduced it, or its goal fails because of it; waive: its presented case does not meet the burden for fixing at its severity. defer: the evidence holds and its scope is outside: neither in the change nor stopping its goal; also a goal finding that a scope exclusion of the goal bars. reject: the evidence does not hold, its scope classification included. An older finding's introduced_by_change reads true as change, false as outside.

reason.description: Why the presented evidence does or does not support the claim, resting on the quotes the reviews present. It decides the item: it never leaves a reading open or names anyone else to decide.

action.description: fix: the change the evidence calls for, as the finding states it, or each option the findings state. defer: gap, trigger, done when. reject: empty. waive: empty.

missing_evidence.description: reject: what the review should have shown. Otherwise empty.

benefit.description: fix, waive: the presented benefit of fixing, the consequence avoided, that decided the ruling. reject, defer: empty.

cost.description: fix, waive: the presented cost of the fix, its verification and the risk it brings, that decided the ruling, or that none was presented. reject, defer: empty.

switching_condition.description: What would have to be presented for another ruling to win: a named claim, never 'if circumstances change'. Given for every ruling, reject and defer included.

coverage_gaps.description: What the reviews did not check: one entry per coverage entry with status not_checked or rule_only, and one per review with no output, copied as the reviews state them. Empty when there are none.

review.description: The review's 1-based place in the collection.

item.description: The coverage item as the review gave it, or "whole review" for a review with no output.

status.description: not_checked, rule_only: the coverage entry's status. incomplete: the review gave no output.

detail.description: The review's detail, or why the review gave no output.
